components.name: Search
components.html: <form class="ds-search"><input type="search" placeholder="Найти своё украшение" aria-label="Поиск"><button aria-label="Искать"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 5 5"/></svg></button></form>
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;border:1px solid #d1d1d1;border-radius:7px;background:#f3eadb;overflow:hidden}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--teal, #124f50)}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;background:none;padding:15px 17px;color:var(--ink, #203e3a);font:400 12px var(--sans, Manrope, sans-serif);outline:none}.ds-search button{padding:0 15px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink, #203e3a);cursor:pointer}.ds-search button:hover{color:var(--teal, #124f50)}.ds-search button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #98643d;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Retail product information
components.description: Cream catalog card information and add control.
components.html:
Тихая гармония

Натуральные камни · демонстрационный товар

2 900 ₽
components.css: .ds-card{background:cream;color:var(--ink, #203e3a);border:1px solid #ededed;border-radius:9px;padding:18px 16px 15px;transition:box-shadow .2s}.ds-card:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 24px #2f1b1410}.ds-card h3{font:500 14px/1.5 var(--sans, Manrope, sans-serif);margin:0}.ds-card p{font:400 10px/1.6 var(--sans, Manrope, sans-serif);color:#52635f;margin:6px 0 0;min-height:32px}.ds-card>div{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:12px;font:700 17px var(--sans, Manrope, sans-serif)}.ds-card button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:var(--teal, #124f50);color:cream;cursor:pointer}.ds-card button:hover{background:#0a393b}.ds-card button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #98643d;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Category navigation
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;overflow:auto;padding:17px 0;border-top:1px solid #eee;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;color:var(--ink, #203e3a);font:400 11px var(--sans, Manrope, sans-serif);cream-space:nowrap}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav button{border:0;background:none;padding:0;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav>:last-child{color:var(--teal, #124f50);font-weight:600}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--teal, #124f50)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #98643d;outline-offset:5px}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #98643d;outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: Deep teal, warm sand and apricot jewelry storefront, explicitly chosen by the user. Existing layout, photography and supplied IVA AMU logo are preserved.
keyCharacteristics: Deep teal hero and primary actions
Warm sand backgrounds and cream catalogue cards
Apricot personal-selection panel and hero accents

rules.name: Retail hierarchy
rules.body: Use teal for primary actions, key icons and promotional sections; keep product information on cream.

dos: Do preserve the supplied olive logo and natural-stone imagery.
Do keep search and selection controls accessible.
Do label demonstration products and prices.
donts: Don't restore the former cream-and-olive page theme.
Don't invent discounts, delivery promises or medical claims.
